The site uses hash navigation. Fragment links open the corresponding client-side view; they are not separate server documents.

## Link Download
The homepage already had link input and media parsing. The work added preview confirmation, a 10-second download preparation state, completion feedback and retry. The web quota is 10 downloads per 24 hours and 50 MB per file. Research, PRD, prototype, quota and exception rules, event definitions and launch follow-up are presented in the portfolio.

## BOSS Job Assistant MCP
The workflow reads a role, matches confirmed personal evidence, drafts a greeting, obtains authorisation, sends through a CDP script and verifies greeting and résumé-image delivery separately. A Python and SQLite ledger records roles and applications.

## Agent Skills
The AI suite presents architecture, 11 skills and an n8n site-audit workflow. Skills include article creation, batch composition, content management, refinement, multilingual flow, asset library, landing pages, event measurement, layouts, page standards and access gateway.
